s: After which movement was Tanguturi Prakasam called Andhra Kesari?
x:
During the Simon Commission protests held at Madras in 1928, Tanguturi Prakasam Pantulu displayed extraordinary courage by confronting armed British police. When the police threatened to fire on the protesters, Prakasam boldly opened his shirt and challenged them to shoot him. His fearless act inspired thousands of freedom fighters and earned him the title "Andhra Kesari" (Lion of Andhra). He later became the first Chief Minister of Andhra State after its formation in 1953. Hence, the correct answer is Option (1).
Exam Note:
• Andhra Kesari – Tanguturi Prakasam
• Occasion – Simon Commission Protest (1928)
